title: Transactional email is now free
summary: Transactional email is now free on every paid Loops plan, and the free plan doubles to 4,000 sends per month. What changed and why.
body_markdown:
**TL;DR**


Starting today, all transactional email sends are free and included with any **paid** Loops plan, starting at $49/month. Our **free** plan has doubled to 4,000 sends, and paid plans now include unlimited transactional sending at no additional cost.


## Why the Change?


As Loops grows, our goal is straightforward: give early-stage software teams a stable, reliable email infrastructure without forcing trade-offs between cost and quality.


By removing incremental pricing on transactional sends, we want you to integrate Loops confidently without having to worry about incremental pricing changes month to month and focus on building your product.


## What’s Changing?


Previously, transactional emails were billed separately at $1 per 2,000 sends. Now:


-


**Free Plan:** **Doubled** from previous 2,000 sends/month to 4,000 sends/month


-


**Paid Plans:** **Unlimited** transactional emails included, starting at $49/month


With no cost overhead for transactional sends, you can route all product-driven emails (alerts, onboarding, feature rollouts) through Loops. This simplifies your email architecture—no need to split providers or manage complex rate limits as you scale.


Instead of micromanaging transactional volume, you can plan your email infrastructure budget with a single slider controlling your contact list size. As your user base scales, email costs remain predictable and transparent.


## Why Are We Doing This?


Most companies raise prices as they mature. We think that’s a mistake. We want to be more accessible at all stages, and hope that as you grow, you’ll continue using Loops. We thrive when you thrive.


For many of you, these changes mean substantial cost savings, especially if transactional emails are a large part of your volume.


## What’s Next?


We’re continually optimizing our backend and delivery logic to reduce costs and pass those savings on to you. All features remain included at any price point.


Have questions? We’re here to help—reach out in-app, via support, or just[send me an email](https://loops.so/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#ef8c879d869caf8380809f9cc19c80) .
